### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

### Groupe

ENGIE est un acteur majeur de la transition énergétique dont la raison d’être est d’agir pour
accélérer la transition vers une économie neutre en carbone. Présent dans 30 pays avec plus de
90 000 collaborateurs, ENGIE couvre toute la chaîne de valeur de l’énergie.

[ chevron_right Découvrir ENGIE ][32]

## Our expertise

Whatever your needs, our technical experts are here to help. We mobilise our rich heritage in core
markets, apply innovation and pursue excellence to solve today's challenges and equip you for
tomorrow's.

### 01 Buildings

Whether you’re in the public or private sector, we can support your project – we work across a broad
range of building types including arts and culture, aviation and ports, commercial, retail and
offices, education, healthcare, local and central government, residential and hotels, sports and
events venues, and transport buildings. 

[Our work in the Buildings market][135]

### 02 Defence and security

We are proud to be a trusted partner for some of the most complex and critical defence and security
equipment and infrastructure programmes worldwide, giving our clients what they need to be
operationally ready and effective. 

[Our work in the Defence and security market][136]

### 03 Energy

We understand energy markets and the different paces of transition. We’ll use our unique breadth of
energy sector technical expertise to co-create solutions with you, and help you deliver them.

[Our work in the Energy market][137]

### 04 Environment and society

Our global network of climate, environment and social experts support clients and project teams to
achieve: sustainability throughout the project lifecycle, a strong reputation with investors and
stakeholders, and innovative, cost-effective solutions.

[Our work in the Environment and society market][138]

### 05 Transport

Effective development and delivery of transport infrastructure is essential to realise the benefits
from efficient and sustainable transport networks. Leveraging our global expertise in urban,
suburban, and rural environments, our experts help clients create solutions that are intuitive and
safe to use – and that maximise wider social, health and environmental outcomes.  

[Our work in the Transport market][139]

### 06 Water

We have more than a century of water management experience and have played leading roles in many of
the world’s largest and most transformative water supply, wastewater, irrigation, drainage, and
flood protection projects. 

[Our work in the Water market][140]

# Commercial & Residential
# Energy Solutions

## Getting it done, RIght!

Request a Quote

## Proudly Employing Indigenous Team Members

At **Canada Energy Audits**, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce that
reflects the communities we serve. As a **Canadian-owned company**, we proudly employ **Indigenous
and other diverse community team members** and actively support Indigenous representation in the
clean energy industry. We believe in creating sustainable, long-term employment opportunities that
respect cultural values and contribute to economic empowerment in Indigenous communities.

This isn’t just a policy—it’s a principle we live by as we work toward a greener, more inclusive
future for all.

## About Canada Energy Audit

**Canada Energy Audit (CEA) is a trusted provider of energy efficiency solutions for homeowners
across Canada, specializing in home energy evaluations. Our certified auditors offer comprehensive
home assessments to help identify opportunities for energy savings, focusing on HVAC systems,
insulation, and other home improvements. As a delivery partner for major rebate programs like the
Enbridge Home Efficiency Rebate, we ensure that homeowners receive maximum value through
energy-efficient upgrades, helping reduce costs while enhancing comfort and sustainability.**

**For commercial clients, CEA offers full-scale energy solutions designed to meet the complex needs
of larger buildings and operations. Our team of engineers and technicians conducts detailed energy
audits, manages the implementation of efficiency measures, and provides long-term strategies for
energy management. We help businesses optimize their energy use, reduce operating costs, and improve
environmental performance, offering tailored services that align with both financial and
sustainability goals.**

[ Learn more ][23]

### improve your home’s energy efficiency

**Enbridge Gas, in collaboration with Save on Energy and supported by the Ontario government, is
helping homeowners improve their energy efficiency and comfort. Through this program, Ontario
residents can access substantial rebates for energy-efficient upgrades, including insulation,
windows, and more. After an initial home energy assessment, a registered energy advisor provides a
customized list of recommended upgrades. Homeowners must complete at least two qualifying upgrades,
such as insulation, windows, or air-source heat pumps, before booking a follow-up energy assessment.
The program also reimburses up to $600 for assessment costs and provides rebates on eligible
upgrades to improve energy efficiency.**

## Rebates Available to You

[ Download HRS Rebate guide ][24]

## COMMERCIAL ENERGY Solutions

**Regarding industrial and commercial HVAC needs in the GTA, CEA is the premier company to call. All
of our certified technicians share our commitment to providing excellent service and meeting or
exceeding our customers’ expectations. If you want assistance with the installation, replacement, or
maintenance of an existing HVAC system, our qualified specialists are at your service.**

**Our licensed CEA professionals stay current with the latest technology and industry standards. Our
commitment to our customers goes beyond the initial purchase and extends throughout the entire
lifespan of your system. As part of our dedication to your complete satisfaction with all of our
products, we will do HVAC repairs, maintenance, and tune-ups as required. Call us now in the GTA if
you have any questions or would like to schedule a commercial HVAC service appointment.**

#### Building Condition Assesment

## Residential Energy EVALUATIONS

**CEA is one of the largest energy audit service providers in Canada, having completed over 100,000
Home Energy Evaluations. **

**Enhance your home for a more sustainable tomorrow with Canada Energy Audits. Our dedicated team is
here to guide you every step of the way, ensuring you make the most of available energy rebate
programs. We'll handle the complexities so you can enjoy a stress-free experience while transforming
your home into a more energy-efficient, comfortable, and environmentally friendly space. **

**With our support, you'll not only save on energy costs but also contribute to a greener future,
all without the hassle. Let us help you create a happier, more sustainable home today!**

[ Learn more ][25]

## The Home Renovation Savings (HRS) Program
* **At least 2 Renovations must be completed.**
* **The home must be heated with Enbridge Gas or Ontario Electricity during either the First or
  Final Audit.**
* **Both main and secondary residences are eligible, but the application must be made by the
  homeowner.**
* **The final audit must be carried out within 180 days of the initial audit**
* **Eligible homes include only detached, semi-detached, row, and mobile homes on a permanent
  foundation.**
* **Participants with a final audit on/after Jan 5, 2026, can get a $500 bonus for installing 3+
  measures**

**The maximum total rebate is $5, 000(Enbridge gas heated) or $10,000 (Electricity heated), which
includes a $600 reimbursement for the Audit Fee. This rebate appliesfor the lifetime of the program
per address. **

* **At least 2 Renovations must be completed.**
* **The home must be heated with Enbridge Gas or Ontario Electricity during either the First or
  Final Audit.**
* **Both main and secondary residences are eligible, but the application must be made by the

* **The final audit must be carried out within 180 days of the initial audit**
* **Eligible homes include only detached, semi-detached, row, and mobile homes on a permanent
  foundation.**

  measures**

* ## How chemistry helps recover more oil
  
  Chevron is improving oil recovery in the Permian Basin by using advanced chemicals to extract more
  oil from existing shale resources.
  
  [ Read the article ][10]
* ## Fueling American progress
  
  As our nation looks back on 250 years, our people remain focused on meeting our country’s energy
  demands today. And fueling the next 250 years of American progress.
  
  [ Read the article ][11]
* ## Chevron and Microsoft making power moves
  
  Chevron is expanding into the power-for-AI business to deliver dedicated, on-site electricity to a
  next-generation Microsoft data center.
  
  [ Read more ][12]
* ## Why we reformulated Techron®
  
  Our team enhanced the Techron® additive in our branded gasolines to provide greater engine
  protection.
  
  [ Learn more ][13]
* ## The Energy Tailgate podcast
  
  With energy top of mind for so many right now, *The Energy Tailgate* brings the conversation down
  to earth with no jargon, just straight talk.
  
  [ Explore episodes ][14]
* ## Inside Chevron’s Comprehensive Wildlife Plan in Colorado
  
  Meet the Colorado native whose team uses GPS data to track where mule deer and pronghorn roam
  throughout the seasons.
  
  [ Read the article ][15]
* ## Chevron’s success in the Permian Basin starts with people
  
  Meet some of our employees who are tapping into advanced technology, data and expertise to support
  long-term value in one of the world’s most important oil-producing regions.
  
  [ Read the article ][16]

## Blue Jay Categories

Electrical metering, Automatic protection relay like insulation monitoring relay, etc.

### [Branch Circuit Metering][56]

### [Branch Circuit Metering][57]

Ideal multi-circuit power metering solutions for commercial new and retrofit projects. One
multi-channel meter can replace multiple ordinary meters. Any metering combinations of four-channel,
six-channel, and eight-channel are possible allowing you to provide flexibility with installations
of electrical metering systems.
[Learn More][58]

### [Multifunctional Panel Metering][59]

### [Multifunctional Panel Metering][60]

Blue Jay's panel or din rail mounted multifunction meters are ideal for monitoring electrical
feeders or busbars in 600V and below systems. These advanced meters provide comprehensive data on
energy consumption, waveform capture, harmonics, and power quality, enabling users to optimize
energy efficiency in buildings, automation, and power distribution networks.
[Learn More][61]

### [DC Metering Solution][62]

### [DC Metering Solution][63]

Ideal DC metering solutions for EV charging stations, solar panels wind turbines, light rail
transit, Data centers, energy storage and other renewable energy systems. With OEM & ODM service,
our DC versatile and accurate metering solutions can meet a variety of DC project.
[Learn More][64]

### [AC DC Insulation Monitoring Device][65]

### [AC DC Insulation Monitoring Device][66]

Comprehensive insulation monitoring relays for electrical safety while charging or driving. Our AC
or DC insulation monitoring devices are widely used to monitor the insulation in electrical
vehicles, EV charging stations, railways, energy storage systems, medical systems, etc.
[Learn More][67]

### [ARC Flash Protection][68]

### [ARC Flash Protection][69]

An innovative solution for LV and MV arc flash protection. High-speed response to arc faults with
arc flash and overcurrent detection. 3-channel, 4-channel, 48-channel arc flash sensor options.
[Learn More][70]

### [Motor Protection][71]

### [Motor Protection][72]

Blue Jay motor protection solutions combine a full range of protection functions including overload,
thermal, phase loss, overcurrent, earth fault, etc. Our multifunctional motor protection relay is
the most competitive and cost-effective solution for LV asynchronous motors, synchronous motors,
pumps, etc.
[Learn More][73]

& protection relay factory in China. With over 10 years of professional experience, Blue Jay
specializes in the development, manufacturing, and sales of high-quality power energy meters and
power automation protection relays. We also provide customized metering and power grid protection
solutions for OEM/ODM customers.
[ Learn More ][74]

# Shaping the future with
# Transformative excellence

End-to-End consultancy delivering grid-scale battery storage solutions, supported by Solar PV, Wind
Energy, and integrated IT, Civil, and Mechanical design consultancy.

[ Talk to Energy Experts ][28]

## Why Devyom

**Devyom Technologies** exists to bridge the gap between ambitious sustainability goals and
practical engineering reality. As the industry shifts toward renewable power, we stand as a
comprehensive partner for **end-to-end solutions**.

Our expertise spans the full project lifecycle—from feasibility studies and tender support to
detailed **Electrical, Civil, and Mechanical design**. Whether it is **Solar PV, BESS, or Green
Hydrogen**, our multidisciplinary approach ensures that every project is technically sound and
economically viable. We combine this technical rigor with **IT innovations** and auditing services,
operating with total **transparency** to deliver value that puts the customer first.

Market Challenges | Devyom Technologies

## Market Challenges in Renewable Energy, Solar & BESS

Key challenges shaping the future of Renewable Energy, Solar Power, and Battery Energy Storage
System (BESS) projects across global markets.
* Complex Solar,BESS , Hybrid and Microgird system sizing and integration (System Engineering Gap)
* Regulatory gaps and policy uncertainty
* Grid integration and transmission capacity constraints
* Rising project costs and financing risks
* Disconnected design vs. construction (Detailed Engineering Gap)
* Gap between Software Analysis & Actual Plant Performance
* Safety, reliability, and thermal risk management
* Shortage of skilled renewable energy professionals

“As Renewable Energy, Solar, and BESS projects expand across diverse regions, early-stage market
assessment, grid readiness, and regulatory clarity are critical for long-term success. Devyom
Technologies supports clients with bankable engineering, optimized system design, and risk
mitigation strategies.”

— Devyom Technologies | Renewable Energy Consulting

## 
## What We offer

#### [Solar Consulting][29]

Feasibility Study & Pre Engineering, System Design & Engineering, Detailed Technical Documentation,
Tender Support, Client Proposal, On-site Services, Energy Yield Analysis, Financial Modeling and
Energy Cost Calculations, Landers Engineering.

#### [Electrical Assessment][30]

Energy Audit & Demand Analysis, Electrical Load Profiling & Demand Analysis, Power Quality & Network
Stability Study, Diesel Generator (DG) Profiling & Displacement Strategy, Renewable Energy (RE)
Generation Study & System Sizing, Techno-Commercial Feasibility & ROI Analysis, RE 100 & NetZero

[ [BESS Consulting] ][31]

#### [BESS Consulting][32]

Technical Feasibility Study and Site Survey, System Sizing & Energy Modeling, Pre-Engineering &
Concept Design, Cost Estimation & Commercial Analysis, RFI/RFQ/Tender Preparation, Client Proposal,
Economic Evaluation, Solution Modeling and Design.

#### [Tender Support][33]

Tender Search and Information, Pre-Engineering Works, Tender Analysis (Technical & Commercial),
Tender Summary & Reporting, Document Preparation (RFI, RFQ, & EoI), Tender Documentation & Bidding
Support..

#### [SwitchYard Design][34]

SLD, layout design, and equipment selection for 11–400 kV switchyards. Protection, earthing, and
safety studies including relay coordination. Technical documentation – BOQ, specifications, and
regulatory compliance. SCADA and automation integration with communication systems. Vendor review,
site supervision, and commissioning support..

#### [Civil Engineering Services][35]

Providing civil estimation, costing, BOQ preparation, site billing, and detailed civil audits for
project accuracy Surveys: Topography & Geotechnical for layout and foundation. Analysis: Shading &
Orientation for yield, plus Access for logistics.

#### [Mechanical Design Services][36]

Optimization: Weight and Material for cost and performance gains. Motion: Kinematics and Motion
Studies for small mechanisms. Presentation: Professional Rendering and Animation for client
communication. Production: Complete Manufacturing Drawings with GD&T for readiness..

#### [Wind Consulting][37]

We provide wind and green hydrogen support through project sizing, feasibility studies, site
surveys, and documentation assistance

#### [Software Services][38]

SketchUp 3D Visualization Services AutoCAD Drafting & Documentation Services SolarGIS ,Pvsyst Sol

# Shaping the future with
# Transformative excellence

End-to-End consultancy delivering grid-scale battery storage solutions, supported by Solar PV, Wind
Energy, and integrated IT, Civil, and Mechanical design consultancy.

[ Talk to Energy Experts ][28]

## Why Devyom

**Devyom Technologies** exists to bridge the gap between ambitious sustainability goals and
practical engineering reality. As the industry shifts toward renewable power, we stand as a
comprehensive partner for **end-to-end solutions**.

Our expertise spans the full project lifecycle—from feasibility studies and tender support to
detailed **Electrical, Civil, and Mechanical design**. Whether it is **Solar PV, BESS, or Green
Hydrogen**, our multidisciplinary approach ensures that every project is technically sound and
economically viable. We combine this technical rigor with **IT innovations** and auditing services,
operating with total **transparency** to deliver value that puts the customer first.

Market Challenges | Devyom Technologies

## Market Challenges in Renewable Energy, Solar & BESS

Key challenges shaping the future of Renewable Energy, Solar Power, and Battery Energy Storage
System (BESS) projects across global markets.
* Complex Solar,BESS , Hybrid and Microgird system sizing and integration (System Engineering Gap)
* Regulatory gaps and policy uncertainty
* Grid integration and transmission capacity constraints
* Rising project costs and financing risks
* Disconnected design vs. construction (Detailed Engineering Gap)
* Gap between Software Analysis & Actual Plant Performance
* Safety, reliability, and thermal risk management
* Shortage of skilled renewable energy professionals

“As Renewable Energy, Solar, and BESS projects expand across diverse regions, early-stage market
assessment, grid readiness, and regulatory clarity are critical for long-term success. Devyom
Technologies supports clients with bankable engineering, optimized system design, and risk
mitigation strategies.”

— Devyom Technologies | Renewable Energy Consulting

## 
## What We offer

#### [Solar Consulting][29]

Feasibility Study & Pre Engineering, System Design & Engineering, Detailed Technical Documentation,
Tender Support, Client Proposal, On-site Services, Energy Yield Analysis, Financial Modeling and
Energy Cost Calculations, Landers Engineering.

#### [Electrical Assessment][30]

Energy Audit & Demand Analysis, Electrical Load Profiling & Demand Analysis, Power Quality & Network
Stability Study, Diesel Generator (DG) Profiling & Displacement Strategy, Renewable Energy (RE)
Generation Study & System Sizing, Techno-Commercial Feasibility & ROI Analysis, RE 100 & NetZero

[ [BESS Consulting] ][31]

#### [BESS Consulting][32]

Technical Feasibility Study and Site Survey, System Sizing & Energy Modeling, Pre-Engineering &
Concept Design, Cost Estimation & Commercial Analysis, RFI/RFQ/Tender Preparation, Client Proposal,
Economic Evaluation, Solution Modeling and Design.

#### [Tender Support][33]

Tender Search and Information, Pre-Engineering Works, Tender Analysis (Technical & Commercial),
Tender Summary & Reporting, Document Preparation (RFI, RFQ, & EoI), Tender Documentation & Bidding
Support..

#### [SwitchYard Design][34]

SLD, layout design, and equipment selection for 11–400 kV switchyards. Protection, earthing, and
safety studies including relay coordination. Technical documentation – BOQ, specifications, and
regulatory compliance. SCADA and automation integration with communication systems. Vendor review,
site supervision, and commissioning support..

#### [Civil Engineering Services][35]

Orientation for yield, plus Access for logistics.

Networking and IT infrastructure setup, Laptop, desktop, printer and system support, CCTV,

## Аудит и консалтинг для вашего бизнеса

«Энерджи Консалтинг» – российская аудиторско-консалтинговая компания с офисами в Москве, Казани и
Альметьевске, обладающая более чем 20-летним опытом сопровождения бизнеса.

Мы оказываем услуги по аудиту и консалтингу крупным промышленным предприятиям, холдингам и другим
клиентам из различных отраслей экономики. За годы работы накоплен опыт, который позволяет учитывать
отраслевую специфику, требования законодательства и реальные потребности бизнеса.

Мы рассматриваем аудит и консалтинг как инструмент для принятия обоснованных управленческих решений.
Поэтому результат нашей работы – не только подготовленные отчёты и заключения, но и практические
рекомендации, направленные на снижение рисков, повышение прозрачности процессов и устойчивое
развитие бизнеса.

## Почему нам доверяют
* Комплексная экспертиза. Аудиторская консалтинговая компания «Энерджи Консалтинг» объединяет
  компетенции аудиторов, налоговых и финансовых консультантов, юристов и специалистов в других
  областях. Это даёт возможность всесторонне оценивать ситуацию и предлагать оптимальные решения для
  бизнеса.
* Признанная квалификация. «Энерджи Консалтинг» входит в число крупнейших аудиторских групп России,
  включена в реестры ОЗО и ОЗОФР и оказывает услуги в строгом соответствии с требованиями
  законодательства и профессиональных стандартов. Компания более 10 лет представлена среди
  крупнейших российских аудиторских групп в ренкинге RAEX в составе группы «ЭйчЭлБи Рус», а также
  участвует в ренкинге «Эксперт РА» как самостоятельная аудиторская организация.
* Ориентация на бизнес-результат. Наша задача – не просто оказывать услуги по аудиту и консалтингу,
  а содействовать стабильному росту компании за счёт эффективного управления процессами.
* Долгосрочное сотрудничество. Мы стремимся быть для клиента не разовым исполнителем, а надёжным
  партнёром на долгосрочной основе. «Энерджи Консалтинг» имеет солидную клиентскую базу, включая
  крупные холдинги, группы компаний, публичные общества и предприятия из различных отраслей.
  Многолетняя работа с такими клиентами позволяет нам глубоко понимать бизнес-процессы, обеспечивать
  преемственность аудиторского подхода и предлагать решения, которые помогают не только закрывать
  текущие задачи, но и поддерживать стратегическое развитие бизнеса. Многие наши клиенты
  сотрудничают с нами много лет, 98 % новых клиентов перезаключают договор на следующие периоды и
  считают нас надежным партнером.

## Аудит и консалтинг для вашего бизнеса

«Энерджи Консалтинг» – российская аудиторско-консалтинговая компания с офисами в Москве, Казани и
Альметьевске, обладающая более чем 20-летним опытом сопровождения бизнеса.

Мы оказываем услуги по аудиту и консалтингу крупным промышленным предприятиям, холдингам и другим
клиентам из различных отраслей экономики. За годы работы накоплен опыт, который позволяет учитывать
отраслевую специфику, требования законодательства и реальные потребности бизнеса.

Мы рассматриваем аудит и консалтинг как инструмент для принятия обоснованных управленческих решений.
Поэтому результат нашей работы – не только подготовленные отчёты и заключения, но и практические
рекомендации, направленные на снижение рисков, повышение прозрачности процессов и устойчивое
развитие бизнеса.

## Почему нам доверяют
* Комплексная экспертиза. Аудиторская консалтинговая компания «Энерджи Консалтинг» объединяет
  компетенции аудиторов, налоговых и финансовых консультантов, юристов и специалистов в других
  областях. Это даёт возможность всесторонне оценивать ситуацию и предлагать оптимальные решения для
  бизнеса.
* Признанная квалификация. «Энерджи Консалтинг» входит в число крупнейших аудиторских групп России,
  включена в реестры ОЗО и ОЗОФР и оказывает услуги в строгом соответствии с требованиями
  законодательства и профессиональных стандартов. Компания более 10 лет представлена среди
  крупнейших российских аудиторских групп в ренкинге RAEX в составе группы «ЭйчЭлБи Рус», а также
  участвует в ренкинге «Эксперт РА» как самостоятельная аудиторская организация.
* Ориентация на бизнес-результат. Наша задача – не просто оказывать услуги по аудиту и консалтингу,
  а содействовать стабильному росту компании за счёт эффективного управления процессами.
* Долгосрочное сотрудничество. Мы стремимся быть для клиента не разовым исполнителем, а надёжным
  партнёром на долгосрочной основе. «Энерджи Консалтинг» имеет солидную клиентскую базу, включая
  крупные холдинги, группы компаний, публичные общества и предприятия из различных отраслей.
  Многолетняя работа с такими клиентами позволяет нам глубоко понимать бизнес-процессы, обеспечивать
  преемственность аудиторского подхода и предлагать решения, которые помогают не только закрывать
  текущие задачи, но и поддерживать стратегическое развитие бизнеса. Многие наши клиенты
  сотрудничают с нами много лет, 98 % новых клиентов перезаключают договор на следующие периоды и
  считают нас надежным партнером.

residential home inspections, commercial property inspections, and energy audits.

At ECE Consulting, we focus on helping buyers, sellers, and real estate professionals make clear,
informed decisions. Whether you’re purchasing a home or a commercial asset—from hospitality and
retail to storage facilities and industrial sites—you can rely on us for thorough inspections,
practical findings, and dependable service that keeps transactions moving smoothly.

# **Energy**
# **Efficiency**
# **Movement**

## The Global Network for Energy Efficiency

## 600+ Companies. One Mission: Energy Efficiency

A global network of industry leaders committed to improving energy performance across sectors.
Collaborating, sharing best practices, and unlocking real business and climate impact.
[Explore our network][30]
[Join the Movement][31]

## Energy Efficiency Solutions Already Exist

They are affordable, scalable and ready for investment. Now is the moment to act.

**The Energy Efficiency Movement is the** **global network **driving** awareness, adoption and
development of energy efficiency solutions **across all industrial sectors.

The Energy Efficiency Movement empowers industry to adopt energy efficiency at scale and accelerate
progress toward net zero.

 

 

1/3

of the CO2 cuts we need can be delivered by energy efficiency.

Reference : IEA, 2024

We help companies move **from interest to action** by making energy efficiency knowledge,
implementation examples, training and partners easier to find and use.

For companies, energy efficiency can **lower operating costs, reduce exposure to energy price
****volatility, improve resilience** and cut emissions using solutions that already exist

By joining the Energy Efficiency Movement, **Movers** have a platform to **communicate** their
energy efficiency needs, **fostering** a collaborative environment that drives impactful change and
long-term **profitability**.

[Join now!][32]

15%

of the industry costs can be slashed through energy efficiency within two years.

Reference : IEA, 2024

## Why Should Your Company Join The Network?

LEARN

**Find practical guidance to identify energy efficiency opportunities, understand available
solutions and take the first steps toward implementation.**

[Shaking hands]

COLLABORATE

**Connect with organizations working on similar challenges, exchange implementation experience and
identify opportunities to accelerate action together.**

BUILD SKILLS

**Build the technical, operational and management capabilities needed to identify, implement and
maintain energy efficiency solutions.**

## Energy Efficiency Investment Report 2026

The 2026 edition of our survey shows that energy efficiency is no longer just a sustainability
topic: 98% of organizations are at least planning to invest in energy efficiency, driven by rising
energy costs and the need for greater resilience and competitiveness.

[Download report »][33]

### **May 2026
### ****Celebrating 5 years of the Energy Efficiency Movement**

In this anniversary video, Linda Pålsson shares why collaboration, collective action, and energy
efficiency are more important than ever to build a resilient and competitive industrial future.

[Watch video »][34]

## 600+ Companies. One Mission: Energy Efficiency

Collaborating, sharing best practices, and unlocking real business and climate impact.

## Energy Efficiency Solutions Already Exist

They are affordable, scalable and ready for investment. Now is the moment to act.

**The Energy Efficiency Movement is the** **global network **driving** awareness, adoption and
development of energy efficiency solutions **across all industrial sectors.

The Energy Efficiency Movement empowers industry to adopt energy efficiency at scale and accelerate
progress toward net zero.

 

 

1/3

of the CO2 cuts we need can be delivered by energy efficiency.

Reference : IEA, 2024

We help companies move **from interest to action** by making energy efficiency knowledge,
implementation examples, training and partners easier to find and use.

For companies, energy efficiency can **lower operating costs, reduce exposure to energy price
****volatility, improve resilience** and cut emissions using solutions that already exist

By joining the Energy Efficiency Movement, **Movers** have a platform to **communicate** their
energy efficiency needs, **fostering** a collaborative environment that drives impactful change and
long-term **profitability**.

[Join now!][32]

15%

of the industry costs can be slashed through energy efficiency within two years.

Reference : IEA, 2024

## Why Should Your Company Join The Network?

LEARN

**Find practical guidance to identify energy efficiency opportunities, understand available
solutions and take the first steps toward implementation.**

[Shaking hands]

COLLABORATE

**Connect with organizations working on similar challenges, exchange implementation experience and
identify opportunities to accelerate action together.**

BUILD SKILLS

**Build the technical, operational and management capabilities needed to identify, implement and
maintain energy efficiency solutions.**

## Energy Efficiency Investment Report 2026

The 2026 edition of our survey shows that energy efficiency is no longer just a sustainability
topic: 98% of organizations are at least planning to invest in energy efficiency, driven by rising
energy costs and the need for greater resilience and competitiveness.

### Heating & Cooling FAQ

## Do you offer HVAC design for new homes?

Yes! We design and build HVAC systems for new construction homes and custom homes. Each homes HVAC
needs are different. There are several factors that influence the best cooling system for your new
home. We’ll make sure you get the residential comfort system that’s right for you and your family.

## What brands do you install?

Your HVAC system is only as good as the euipment that runs it so we only use the highest quality
products and materials from manufacturers like Carrier, Trane, Rheem and Goodman. If you’re unsure
which type of cooling system would work best for your needs, we can walk you through all of your
options.

## What is the life expectancy of my HVAC system?

How often you run your system, the system’s age, its make and model, and whether or not it was
serviced regularly over the course of its life can all play a significant role in how long your
system will last you. Routine maintenance inspections are a good way to prevent problems from
occurring and keep the unit running at its maximum efficiency for years to come.

## Do I need HVAC maintenance?

Absolutely! Every home HVAC system requires maintenance. It's recommended that you have a spring and
fall service to keep your system running efficiently. Our service and maintenance technicians are
trained to spot any potential problem that may occur with your system.

#### Home Energy Consultants

## Air Conditioning & Heating Experts

We offer a variety of cooling and heating services for your home, including upgrades, repairs,
replacements, and new construction HVAC design and installations.

##### [ New Construction Design & Install ][111]

With years of industry experience, we know just what it takes to design and install a custom HVAC
system for your residential or commercial property

##### [ HVAC Retrofits ][112]

What is a retrofit? Retrofitting optimizes your equipment by integrating new components that improve
HVAC efficiency without having to replace your unit.

##### [ Repairs ][113]

Is your system not cooling? Is your system struggling to heat your home? Our trained technicians can
troubleshoot and repair to get your system back up and runnning!

##### [ Maintenance ][114]

Ask us about our Energy Saving Maintenance Program (ESMP) to keep your systems running at peak
performance throughout the year.

##### [ Central Vac Systems ][115]

Our whole home central vacuum systems remove dirt and debris from your home through tubing installed
inside the walls of your home.

##### [ Energy Consulting & Testing ][116]

Home Energy Audits identify multiple ways to increase your homes energy efficiency and help save you
money on heating and cooling costs.

### Heating & Cooling FAQ

## Do you offer HVAC design for new homes?

Yes! We design and build HVAC systems for new construction homes and custom homes. Each homes HVAC
needs are different. There are several factors that influence the best cooling system for your new
home. We’ll make sure you get the residential comfort system that’s right for you and your family.

## What brands do you install?

Your HVAC system is only as good as the euipment that runs it so we only use the highest quality
products and materials from manufacturers like Carrier, Trane, Rheem and Goodman. If you’re unsure
which type of cooling system would work best for your needs, we can walk you through all of your
options.

## What is the life expectancy of my HVAC system?

How often you run your system, the system’s age, its make and model, and whether or not it was
serviced regularly over the course of its life can all play a significant role in how long your
system will last you. Routine maintenance inspections are a good way to prevent problems from
occurring and keep the unit running at its maximum efficiency for years to come.

## Do I need HVAC maintenance?

Absolutely! Every home HVAC system requires maintenance. It's recommended that you have a spring and
fall service to keep your system running efficiently. Our service and maintenance technicians are
trained to spot any potential problem that may occur with your system.

# Everllence - Moving big things to zero

[ Learn more about our new name ][162]

What we do

## We provide decarbonization technologies for global shipping, energy generation, and industry

Shipping, power generation, and heavy industry produce nearly a third of the world’s carbon
emissions. These are the hardest sectors to decarbonize and the most essential to keep running.
Energy infrastructure operates at massive scale and is tightly interwoven with global supply chains.
Transforming it is complex – but it must start now. This is exactly where we come in. We develop the
technologies that make decarbonization practical and economical for the industries the world depends
on. From the engines that power global trade to the heat pumps that warm entire cities.

[Learn more about our Focus][163]

Future Technologies

## Explore our technologies for a net-zero future

[ Retrofits
][164]
[ Carbon Capture
][165]
[ Future Fuel Engines
][166]
[ Heat Pumps
][167]

> “We have the opportunity to decarbonize industries that are crucial for the world economy. That’s
> why we get out of bed every morning.”  

Dr Uwe Lauber, CEO Everllence

## We work across key sectors of the world economy – where every reduction in emissions counts most

## What moves us forward

Career

### Working at Everllence

Are you looking to  leverage your existing knowledge and expertise to drive innovation? Or do you
want to  start your career with a global leader  in engineering and technology? Are you ready to
make a lasting impact as part of our team at Everllence and move big things to zero with us?

[ Learn more about our career opportunities
][172]
Digitalization

### Data is the future’s DNA

We at Everllence therefore enable you to increase the efficiency, reliability and maintenance of
your products. By introducing our digital key products CEON and PrimeServ Assist, we created a
comprehensive digital ecosystem that allows us to collect, combine and evaluate relevant data. This
databased ecosystem is our digital backbone and the base for new digital customer centric solutions
of the future.
[ Learn more about Digitalization at Everllence
][173]

Discover Stories

## Gain deep insights into our projects

Discover Story

### From fertilizer to marine fuel

Ammonia is moving from concept to reality. In Japan, Everllence and its licensee Mitsui E&S are
testing the world's first commercial large-bore ME-LGIA engine, verifying consumption, emissions and
safety before the engine goes to sea on a bulk carrier. A decisive step toward carbon-free shipping.

[Read Story][174]

Discover Story

### Charting the IMO's course to net-zero

A one-year pause in the IMO Net-Zero Framework leaves the shipping industry without the rules it was
waiting for. Experts from Everllence and DNV explain what the framework still promises, why the
earliest entry into force is now 2028, and why the work on fuels, pricing and compliance must
continue regardless.

What we do

## We provide decarbonization technologies for global shipping, energy generation, and industry

Shipping, power generation, and heavy industry produce nearly a third of the world’s carbon
emissions. These are the hardest sectors to decarbonize and the most essential to keep running.
Energy infrastructure operates at massive scale and is tightly interwoven with global supply chains.
Transforming it is complex – but it must start now. This is exactly where we come in. We develop the
technologies that make decarbonization practical and economical for the industries the world depends
on. From the engines that power global trade to the heat pumps that warm entire cities.

[Learn more about our Focus][163]

# Connecting what matters.
* [Solar & Energy][1]
* [Welding][2]

[In the center is a man in uniform with a Fronius welding machine, walking along a roof covered with
solar panels.]

## Making connections since 1945.

**Fronius is a global corporation specializing in **welding technology, photovoltaics, and battery
charging technology.**

Since **1945**, we have been developing solutions that stand for **quality, reliability, and
durability.** With around 6,500 employees in **37 subsidiaries,** we focus on innovation and
sustainability in order to provide our customers around the world with the best possible products
and services.

Guided by the principle of “Connecting what matters”, we connect people, materials, and energy to
build a **safe and sustainable world.**

Fronius Solar & Energy
Electricity is the thread that binds our business and our world together. By focusing on energy
sector integration, our solutions connect the sun with the grid, the grid with mobility, and energy
systems with efficiency.
[Discover Fronius Solar & Energy][3]
Fronius Welding
Our welding technology is designed to forge unbreakable bonds between metals for decades to come.
[Discover Fronius Welding][4]
About us
How did it all begin? Who are our customers? And how can you apply to join us? Discover our story.
[Learn more about us][5]
Latest news
In our press and news area you’ll find all the latest updates about our products and the company.
[Latest news & press releases][6]

## Our new product highlights

### Reserva—the Fronius storage solution

Use solar energy around the clock with the Fronius Reserva. The high-voltage battery with DC
coupling ensures a highly efficient energy transfer. Thanks to its modular capacity of 6.3 to 15.8
kWh, the Reserva can be flexibly adapted to your needs. Designed to work seamlessly with Fronius
hybrid inverters, it slots perfectly into your PV system. Your data remains secure on European
servers, while our proven service and support network is always there for you.

[Learn more about the Fronius Reserva][7]
[Fronius Reserva]

### Fronius Fortis—the next-gen manual MIG/MAG welding machine

Welding tasks are often a challenge, especially for small and medium-sized companies. Some of the
tasks change on a daily basis, as do the required welding processes. This calls for a welding
machine that can be adapted perfectly to these dynamic conditions.

[Learn more about the Fronius Fortis][8]
[Fronius Fortis]

## Fronius News

[Fronius employee]

## Fronius as an employer

As a family business, we are characterized by a special spirit—a sense of togetherness that shapes
our corporate culture. Whether in development, production, or our international teams, together we
embody “Connecting what matters” to create solutions that make a real difference today and tomorrow.
We are Fronius.

# Connecting what matters.
* [Solar & Energy][1]
* [Welding][2]

[In the center is a man in uniform with a Fronius welding machine, walking along a roof covered with
solar panels.]

## Making connections since 1945.

**Fronius is a global corporation specializing in **welding technology, photovoltaics, and battery
charging technology.**

Since **1945**, we have been developing solutions that stand for **quality, reliability, and
durability.** With around 6,500 employees in **37 subsidiaries,** we focus on innovation and
sustainability in order to provide our customers around the world with the best possible products
and services.

Guided by the principle of “Connecting what matters”, we connect people, materials, and energy to
build a **safe and sustainable world.**

Fronius Solar & Energy
Electricity is the thread that binds our business and our world together. By focusing on energy
sector integration, our solutions connect the sun with the grid, the grid with mobility, and energy
systems with efficiency.
[Discover Fronius Solar & Energy][3]
Fronius Welding
Our welding technology is designed to forge unbreakable bonds between metals for decades to come.
[Discover Fronius Welding][4]
About us
How did it all begin? Who are our customers? And how can you apply to join us? Discover our story.
[Learn more about us][5]
Latest news
In our press and news area you’ll find all the latest updates about our products and the company.
[Latest news & press releases][6]

## Our new product highlights

### Reserva—the Fronius storage solution

Use solar energy around the clock with the Fronius Reserva. The high-voltage battery with DC
coupling ensures a highly efficient energy transfer. Thanks to its modular capacity of 6.3 to 15.8
kWh, the Reserva can be flexibly adapted to your needs. Designed to work seamlessly with Fronius
hybrid inverters, it slots perfectly into your PV system. Your data remains secure on European
servers, while our proven service and support network is always there for you.

[Learn more about the Fronius Reserva][7]
[Fronius Reserva]

### Fronius Fortis—the next-gen manual MIG/MAG welding machine

Welding tasks are often a challenge, especially for small and medium-sized companies. Some of the
tasks change on a daily basis, as do the required welding processes. This calls for a welding
machine that can be adapted perfectly to these dynamic conditions.

[Learn more about the Fronius Fortis][8]
[Fronius Fortis]

As a family business, we are characterized by a special spirit—a sense of togetherness that shapes
our corporate culture. Whether in development, production, or our international teams, together we
embody “Connecting what matters” to create solutions that make a real difference today and tomorrow.
We are Fronius.

At GE Vernova, we are united by a single, urgent, and optimistic mission: electrify to thrive and
decarbonize. The world needs us to accelerate the transition to more reliable, affordable, and
sustainable energy. Together, we have the energy to change the world.

With a relentless passion for innovation and a diverse portfolio of leading technologies, GE Vernova
is continuing to electrify the world while simultaneously decarbonizing it. We will help reduce the
carbon-intensity of the world’s power systems by reducing the CO2 per kWh produced.

[Contact Us][50]

###### Come bring the energy to change the world

We are approximately 85,000 strong across about 100 countries around the world. If you are ready to

### [Nuclear Science is Transforming Rainbow Trout Farming in Latin America][158]

From freshwater rivers, lakes and lagoons to coastal marine cages, trout farming is a dynamic sub
sector of aquaculture in Latin America, which supports thousands of livelihoods across the region.
But trout raised in open water farms are vulnerable to diseases that spread easily in water.

## Global Strategic Initiatives

The energy transition is about investing in people as well as projects. Masdar’s strategic
initiatives empower women and young people to become sustainability leaders, reward grassroots
sustainability solutions and foster global collaboration.

## Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week

Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week (ADSW) is a global sustainability platform that convenes world leaders
to develop action-oriented solutions to the most pressing challenge of our time: climate change.

## ~40,000

attendees

## 175

countries represented

## 600

speakers from around the world

## Youth 4 Sustainability

The main objective of Y4S is to reach up to one million youth by 2030 through a blended learning
experience, to create awareness of the skills needed for future jobs in sustainability, and to
support the growth of the next generation of sustainability leaders through the Future
Sustainability Leaders and Sustainability Ambassadors programs, and global outreach activities.

## +535k

youth connected via social media

## +39k

young people engaged with Y4S online and in-person activations

## 183

workshops and training sessions

## WiSER

Women in Sustainability, Environment and Renewable Energy (WiSER) is a global platform dedicated to
inspiring women to play an active role in addressing global sustainability challenges.

## +150

Pioneers Program graduates, +30 nationalities

## +470

hours of one-to-one mentorship

## +215

hours of workshops with WiSER pioneers

[ LEARN ABOUT OUR STRATEGIC INITIATIVES ][99]
[...]

About Masdar

## The UAE’s global renewables company

Masdar is a clean energy pioneer positioning the UAE at the forefront of the worldwide energy
transition.

[ Learn More About Masdar ][100]

CAREERS

## The Masdar experience

[ CHECK OUT OUR VACANCIES ][101]

## Power to Change

Find out how Masdar is a source of hope, power, and change for people and communities around the
world.

[ [YT-video-poster] ][102]
[play-button]

## [ How Uzbekistan is shaping a clean energy future with Masdar ][103]

Masdar’s latest Power to Change documentary takes us to Uzbekistan, where Masdar is driving one of
Central Asia’s most ambitious renewable energy programs.

[ [YT-video-poster] ][104]
[play-button]

## [ How Masdar is solving the “moonshot challenge” of renewables ][105]

At this year’s Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week, Masdar launched a solution to “the moonshot challenge
of our time” – overcoming the intermittency barrier for renewable energy.

[ [YT-video-poster] ][106]
[play-button]

## [ Masdar showcases all-Saudi team behind solar-powered electric vehicle ][107]

Masdar released an episode of Power to Change, its original documentary series, spotlighting the
Kingdom of Saudi Arabia’s emerging role as a regional renewable energy leader, through the eyes of
the country’s next generation of clean power innovators.

[ [YT-video-poster] ][108]
[play-button]

## [ Masdar harnesses power of AI to protect birds of prey at Zarafshan wind farm ][109]

Wind farms can represent a real risk for birds of prey but thanks to the power of AI, Masdar is
helping to protect them against the risk of colliding with turbines at the 500MW Zarafshan wind farm
in Uzbekistan.

## Global Strategic Initiatives

The energy transition is about investing in people as well as projects. Masdar’s strategic
initiatives empower women and young people to become sustainability leaders, reward grassroots
sustainability solutions and foster global collaboration.

## Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week

Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week (ADSW) is a global sustainability platform that convenes world leaders
to develop action-oriented solutions to the most pressing challenge of our time: climate change.

## ~40,000

attendees

## 175

countries represented

## 600

speakers from around the world

## Youth 4 Sustainability

The main objective of Y4S is to reach up to one million youth by 2030 through a blended learning
experience, to create awareness of the skills needed for future jobs in sustainability, and to
support the growth of the next generation of sustainability leaders through the Future
Sustainability Leaders and Sustainability Ambassadors programs, and global outreach activities.

## +535k

youth connected via social media

## +39k

young people engaged with Y4S online and in-person activations

## 183

workshops and training sessions

## WiSER

Women in Sustainability, Environment and Renewable Energy (WiSER) is a global platform dedicated to
inspiring women to play an active role in addressing global sustainability challenges.

## +150

Pioneers Program graduates, +30 nationalities

## +470

hours of one-to-one mentorship

## +215

hours of workshops with WiSER pioneers

[ LEARN ABOUT OUR STRATEGIC INITIATIVES ][99]
[...]

About Masdar

## The UAE’s global renewables company

Masdar is a clean energy pioneer positioning the UAE at the forefront of the worldwide energy
transition.

[ Learn More About Masdar ][100]

CAREERS

## The Masdar experience

[ CHECK OUT OUR VACANCIES ][101]

## Power to Change

Find out how Masdar is a source of hope, power, and change for people and communities around the
world.

[ [YT-video-poster] ][102]
[play-button]

## [ How Uzbekistan is shaping a clean energy future with Masdar ][103]

Masdar’s latest Power to Change documentary takes us to Uzbekistan, where Masdar is driving one of
Central Asia’s most ambitious renewable energy programs.

[ [YT-video-poster] ][104]
[play-button]

## [ How Masdar is solving the “moonshot challenge” of renewables ][105]

At this year’s Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week, Masdar launched a solution to “the moonshot challenge
of our time” – overcoming the intermittency barrier for renewable energy.

[ [YT-video-poster] ][106]
[play-button]

## [ Masdar showcases all-Saudi team behind solar-powered electric vehicle ][107]

Masdar released an episode of Power to Change, its original documentary series, spotlighting the
Kingdom of Saudi Arabia’s emerging role as a regional renewable energy leader, through the eyes of
the country’s next generation of clean power innovators.

[ [YT-video-poster] ][108]
[play-button]

## [ Masdar harnesses power of AI to protect birds of prey at Zarafshan wind farm ][109]

Wind farms can represent a real risk for birds of prey but thanks to the power of AI, Masdar is
helping to protect them against the risk of colliding with turbines at the 500MW Zarafshan wind farm
in Uzbekistan.

# Powering Progress, Everywhere.

From college campuses to manufacturing floors, we bring energy solutions to life.

[Explore Our Solutions][56]

## Built for the Way You Operate

Whether you manage facilities, run programs, or oversee systems, we bring energy insight to fit your
world — and your industry.

## Utilities

We design, deliver, and evaluate utility programs that drive real results.

[Power Smarter Programs][57]

## Government

Maximize taxpayer value with smart energy solutions for civic spaces.

[Serve Smarter, Spend Less][58]

## Cold Storage/3PL

Optimize refrigeration and facility performance while increasing reliability.

[Cut Costs, Stay Cold][59]

## Higher Education

Support sustainability goals and long-term savings across campus.

[Advance Campus Performance][60]

## Healthcare

Enhance comfort, control and costs in critical care environments.

[Heal with Efficiency][61]

## Hospitality

Deliver comfort your guests notice — and energy savings they don’t.

[Comfort Meets Control][62]
[img_joules_v2]

## Real Solutions. Real Results.

From energy programs that exceed savings goals to facility upgrades that pay off fast, our case
studies show what happens when deep technical insight meets practical execution.

[See the Proof][63]

rate us 4.6 out of 5 for overall satisfaction, with some partnerships lasting 30+ years. We’re proud
to be recognized nationally for our growth, technical expertise, and program excellence — but we’re
even prouder to be the team our clients trust, year after year.

BERLIN, GERMANY, Sept. 5, 2025 – Midea, part of the Midea Group and a 2025 Fortune Global 500
company, unveiled its exhibition theme of "Master Your Home" at IFA 2025 by showcasing a range of
its latest innovations that holistically empower users to make themselves at home. This means

Saxena as the Country Head for its India operations. Mr. Siddharth brings extensive leadership
experience and a strategic vision to his role as Country Head, where he will focus on further
strengthening Midea’s well-established position in the Indian market. He will drive the company’s
strategic initiatives, expand its consumer base, and enhance brand presence across the country.

## Economies are built at the execution layer, not the AI factory

The Problem

## Inference & compute are solved.
## Operations are not

Teams can run a model. What they cannot do reliably is discover, coordinate, observe, secure, and
broker agents across devices and multi-cloud in one runtime. That is the operationalization gap.

### Stuck at proof of concept

90% of AI pilots never reach production. The barrier is not the model or the compute. It is
everything that has to happen for agents to run reliably at scale.

### Agents arrived. The stack didn't

Containers, centralized choreography, security by firewall and VPN, cloud-first architectures and
CI/CD tools: app-era band-aids force-fit onto Agentix systems that behave differently by nature.

### More than models and GPUs

Where will your agents run? How do they discover and interact? What if there is no connectivity? How
do you avoid vendor lock-in? Intelligence and compute alone cannot answer these.

[Fay Arjomandi]

“An agent is not an application. An agent is an actor that arrived inside the building like a
person.”

**Fay Arjomandi**Founder and CEO
[Read the post →][44]
The solution

## mimOE closes the operationalization gap

One lightweight Operating Engine that makes any device a first-class node in your Agentic AI
(Agentix) network. Develop with any tools, embed mimOE, and agents discover, network, and execute
securely across the continuum, under your control.

Lightweight|Powerful|Versatile
**From PoC to production, one engine**The same 10 to 20 MB Operating Engine from first device to
full fleet. No rearchitecting at scale, no rebuild when hardware changes.
**Purpose-built for Agentix, not retrofitted**Discovery, choreography, zero-trust security, and
observability are engine properties, not custom integration bolted on from the app era.
**Operations answered out of the box**Where agents run, how they discover each other, what happens
offline, who controls execution: answered by one Operating Engine, with Sovereignty in Execution
preserved.

## Economies are built at the execution layer, not the AI factory

The Problem

## Inference & compute are solved.
## Operations are not

Teams can run a model. What they cannot do reliably is discover, coordinate, observe, secure, and
broker agents across devices and multi-cloud in one runtime. That is the operationalization gap.

### Stuck at proof of concept

90% of AI pilots never reach production. The barrier is not the model or the compute. It is
everything that has to happen for agents to run reliably at scale.

### Agents arrived. The stack didn't

Containers, centralized choreography, security by firewall and VPN, cloud-first architectures and
CI/CD tools: app-era band-aids force-fit onto Agentix systems that behave differently by nature.

### More than models and GPUs

Where will your agents run? How do they discover and interact? What if there is no connectivity? How
do you avoid vendor lock-in? Intelligence and compute alone cannot answer these.

[Fay Arjomandi]

“An agent is not an application. An agent is an actor that arrived inside the building like a
person.”

**Fay Arjomandi**Founder and CEO
[Read the post →][44]
The solution

## mimOE closes the operationalization gap

One lightweight Operating Engine that makes any device a first-class node in your Agentic AI
(Agentix) network. Develop with any tools, embed mimOE, and agents discover, network, and execute
securely across the continuum, under your control.

Lightweight|Powerful|Versatile
**From PoC to production, one engine**The same 10 to 20 MB Operating Engine from first device to
full fleet. No rearchitecting at scale, no rebuild when hardware changes.
**Purpose-built for Agentix, not retrofitted**Discovery, choreography, zero-trust security, and
observability are engine properties, not custom integration bolted on from the app era.
**Operations answered out of the box**Where agents run, how they discover each other, what happens
offline, who controls execution: answered by one Operating Engine, with Sovereignty in Execution
preserved.

   at the end of 12 months unless cancelled at the standard price. Offer can only be redeemed once
   per household. We reserve the right to amend or withdraw this offer at any time.
3. Available to OVO Energy customers only. To be eligible you must meet the eligibility criteria set
   out during sign up. Subject to availability, and can be amended or withdrawn at any time.

   boiler plus a free boiler service worth £84. Free boiler service is not available for existing
   CORGI HomePlan, OVO boiler cover and boiler service customers or customers who have had a plan in
   the last 30 days. The annual boiler service plan automatically renews at standard price at the
   end of 12 months unless cancelled. To be eligible you must meet the eligibility criteria set out
   during sign up. Subject to availability, and can be amended or withdrawn at any time.

   energy rate will stay the same, but your EV charging will be charged separately at one fixed
   monthly cost including both your home and public charging miles. The £460 saving is based on a
   Charge Anytime customer signing up to the Premium Monthly Plan and using 12,000 miles a year of
   home charging and 600 miles on the road using public charging networks compared to a customer
   charging their home miles at OVO's UK average SVT rate of 26.34p per kWh and their public miles
   at an average Charge Point Operator rate of 80p per kWh. The Premium Monthly Plan has a monthly
   cost of £37.50 which includes both the home and public charging mileage. Mileage is calculated at
   an efficiency of 4 miles per kWh. Actual savings will vary depending on vehicle efficiency,
   driving style, EV charging usage, the cost per kWh of your standard home energy tariff and the
   rate you pay on public Charge Point Operator networks.
6. [See full Beyond terms here][90] and all [Beyond offer terms here][91]. All offers are subject to
   availability and OVO reserves the right to replace or amend the range and value of available
   offers at any time. Solar panels offer: The 5 free solar panels offer is only available to OVO
   customers who also have solar panels and a battery installed with OVO. Solar panels are
   redeemable as a discount worth up to £500 when the customer buys a OVO solar installation and
   battery package. An average sized house requires 10 solar panels. Panels may be accrued over a 2
   year period and redeemed anytime with either the 2 year accrual period or the 3 years following.
   Subject to availability. Discount is based on current hardware costs. Terms and eligibility
   criteria apply. Free electric miles offer: Earn up to 2,400 free EV miles over 2 years to redeem
   when you join Charge Anytime. Free miles can be redeemed at anytime during the 2 year accrual
   period or within 3 years thereafter. Compatible EV/charger is required for Charge Anytime. New
   Charge Anytime customers only. Free miles are payable as a credit to your energy account. Actual
   free miles may vary depending on the type of vehicle, vehicle efficiency, and driving style.

7. These annual energy savings are dependent on your property type and location, roof type, slope
   and size. If your roof is shaded or isn't south facing, figures are likely to be lower. We based
   the figure on the following: a) You have 12 (440W) solar panels and a 9.5 kWh battery installed
   b) You’re home all day with an annual electricity consumption of 2,500 kWh (Ofgem). You currently
   pay our Standard Variable Rate of 27.30p (correct at 1 April 2025) and will use 51% of what you
   generate c) You sign up for our exclusive SEG rate (20p kWh) for customers who purchase solar and
   a battery from us, and you sell back the remaining 49% of energy generated. You’ll get a more
   accurate savings estimation once we’ve surveyed your property.

# Proudly Serving Clients Since 1947

## [Utility Solutions][20]

We specialize in planning, designing, and evaluating vital power delivery infrastructures for our
electric utility clients including substations, distribution and transmission lines, SCADA systems,
smart grid applications, renewable energy systems, and more.

## [Civil Engineering & Geomatics][21]

Our civil engineering and land surveying services including site development and land planning,
environmental planning and reporting, structural design and analysis, and specialized route surveys
for transmission and distribution lines.

## [Testing & Commissioning][22]

P&D offers comprehensive testing and commissioning of complex electrical and mechanical components,
equipment, systems and controls for utilities and other mission-critical facilities across the
United States and around the world.

## [Smart Grid Solutions][23]

Clients count on P&D for automation, control, and communication solutions for managing power
delivery infrastructures with services such as operational technology planning, design and
implementation, application integration, microgrid consulting, and more.

## Stay Up-to-date with P&D uPDate

The P&D uPDate blog contains articles and information, both original and curated, on topics of
interest to clients and subscribers, as well as news releases and announcements about the
“goings-on” at P&D. Visit the uPDate and subscribe to receive an e-mail when new items are posted.

[Subscribe][24]

## Careers at Patterson & Dewar

Rated one of the AJC’s Top Workplaces, P&D is a cohesive and collaborative team of talented people.
We offer competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, and the opportunity to learn,
grow and contribute to a vibrant culture that stands the test of time.

[Working at P&D][25]

## Questions? Talk to a P&D Expert Today!  [Contact Us][26]

#### About P&D

Established in 1947, P&D is an employee-owned firm that delivers expert engineering services and
results-oriented solutions. We approach each project with an unyielding commitment to excellence and
integrity; these guiding principles make us a trusted ally to the clients we proudly serve.

#### Our Solutions

P&D specializes in designing and evaluating vital power delivery infrastructures. We address the
unique challenges our clients face with a wide range of electrical and civil engineering, land
surveying, construction management, testing & commissioning, and smart grid consulting services.

# Proudly Serving Clients Since 1947

## [Utility Solutions][20]

We specialize in planning, designing, and evaluating vital power delivery infrastructures for our
electric utility clients including substations, distribution and transmission lines, SCADA systems,
smart grid applications, renewable energy systems, and more.

## [Civil Engineering & Geomatics][21]

Our civil engineering and land surveying services including site development and land planning,
environmental planning and reporting, structural design and analysis, and specialized route surveys
for transmission and distribution lines.

## [Testing & Commissioning][22]

P&D offers comprehensive testing and commissioning of complex electrical and mechanical components,
equipment, systems and controls for utilities and other mission-critical facilities across the
United States and around the world.

## [Smart Grid Solutions][23]

Clients count on P&D for automation, control, and communication solutions for managing power
delivery infrastructures with services such as operational technology planning, design and
implementation, application integration, microgrid consulting, and more.

## Stay Up-to-date with P&D uPDate

The P&D uPDate blog contains articles and information, both original and curated, on topics of
interest to clients and subscribers, as well as news releases and announcements about the
“goings-on” at P&D. Visit the uPDate and subscribe to receive an e-mail when new items are posted.

[Subscribe][24]

## Careers at Patterson & Dewar

Rated one of the AJC’s Top Workplaces, P&D is a cohesive and collaborative team of talented people.
We offer competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, and the opportunity to learn,
grow and contribute to a vibrant culture that stands the test of time.

[Working at P&D][25]

## Questions? Talk to a P&D Expert Today!  [Contact Us][26]

#### About P&D

Established in 1947, P&D is an employee-owned firm that delivers expert engineering services and
results-oriented solutions. We approach each project with an unyielding commitment to excellence and
integrity; these guiding principles make us a trusted ally to the clients we proudly serve.

#### Our Solutions

P&D specializes in designing and evaluating vital power delivery infrastructures. We address the
unique challenges our clients face with a wide range of electrical and civil engineering, land
surveying, construction management, testing & commissioning, and smart grid consulting services.

Same service. Same quality. But they’re visible everywhere — and you’re not.

We changed that for a construction company in 30 days.

[[Construction company went from 0 to 668 pages indexed on Google in 30 days with Visibility
Engine]][19]

## How We Make You Visible Everywhere

Six steps. Zero guesswork. Customers find you in days, not months.

1Scan
2Plan
3Build
4Publish
5Rank
6Dominate

### We Scan Your Business

Our AI crawls your website and extracts your services, service areas, phone number, and competitive
landscape. In seconds, we know exactly what you offer and where you serve.

✅Services detected automatically
✅Service areas mapped by state + city
✅Competitors identified
✅Industry classified for schema

### We Map Your Page Architecture

Based on your scan, we map out every page your business needs: main service pages, regional pages
for each state and county, city-specific pages, and blog posts answering the questions your
customers are searching for.

📅Main service pages

### AI + Human Expertise Builds Every Page

Every page is written with real details about that city — population, landmarks, neighborhoods, what
the area is known for. Swap the city name and the content doesn’t work anymore. That’s how specific
it is. Google and AI search reward that.

✍️Written so AI search cites you
✍️Built for AI citations
✍️Real local details per city
✍️Pages connected so Google crawls everything

County. With harsh winters dropping below 20°F, reliable hot water is essential…

### Published to Your WordPress Site

Pages go live on YOUR domain — not ours. Every page goes live on YOUR website with full SEO
settings, mobile-ready design, and nothing breaks your existing site. If publishing pauses, it picks
up exactly where it left off.

🚀Published directly to your website
🚀SEO titles and descriptions set automatically

We submit every page to Google’s Indexing API and IndexNow for Bing. Your pages get picked up and

How fast will I see results?+

Most clients see pages indexed within days of publishing. Depending on your industry and
competition, you can start ranking for local searches within 2-4 weeks. We've had clients go from

searchers. Generic, copy-paste pages get penalized. Ours don't.

How fast will I see results?+

Will 2,000 pages hurt my site or look spammy?+

No. Every page is unique — written with real local details like population, landmarks,
neighborhoods, and drive times for that specific city. Google rewards this because it helps
searchers. Generic, copy-paste pages get penalized. Ours don't.

Do I need to do anything on my end?+

You give us WordPress access and answer a few questions about your services and service areas.
That's it. We handle everything — research, writing, building, publishing, search engine submission,
and rank tracking. This is a done-for-you service, not a tool. Most clients spend less than an hour

roofer near me," your business shows up as the answer. 72% of pages cited by AI have the exact
structure we build into every page.

Engines for construction, legal, dental, financial services, addiction treatment, real estate, pool
companies, and 30+ other industries.

The Visibility Engine works alongside your existing SEO. It doesn't replace your current pages — it
adds hundreds or thousands of new ones that capture searches you're currently missing. Most agencies
can't build at this scale.

Global Sustainable Development Report
The Global Sustainable Development Report (GSDR) is a United Nations publication aiming to
strengthen the science-policy interface, produced once every four years to inform the quadrennial
SDG review deliberations. The next report is scheduled for release in September 2027 ahead of the
High-level Political Forum on sustainable development to be held under the auspices of the General
Assembly (SDG Summit). [Global Sustainable Development Report][77] [GSDR in 2027][78] [GSDR in
2023][79]
Energy
Achieving SDG7 will open a new world of opportunities for millions of people through new economic
opportunities and jobs, empowered women, children and youth, better education and health, more
sustainable, equitable and inclusive communities, and greater protections from, and resilience to,
climate change. [Energy Compacts][80] [More on Energy][81]
Sustainable Transport
While there is no single dedicated Sustainable Development Goal for transport, it is reflected in
several SDG targets and recognized as an enabler for achieving many of the goals. The United Nations
Decade of Sustainable Transport will be an opportunity to further raise awareness of transport’s
crucial role in advancing the Sustainable Development Goals and to gather and rally new solutions,
resources and partnerships to advance sustainable transport globally. [UN Decade of Sustainable
Transport 2026 – 2035][82] [More on Sustainable Transport][83]
Water
Water is fundamental to sustainable development, underpinning health, food security, energy,
ecosystems, and economic growth. Ensuring universal access to safe drinking water and sanitation,
improving water quality, strengthening water management, and enhancing resilience to water-related
risks are essential for achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and addressing climate change
impacts. The 2026 UN Water Conference will take place from 2–4 December 2026 in the United Arab
Emirates. Co-hosted by Senegal and the United Arab Emirates, the Conference aims to accelerate the
implementation of SDG 6 on clean water and sanitation, strengthen global water governance, and
further elevate water-related issues on the international agenda through concrete action and
partnerships. [2026 UN Water Conference][84] [More on Water and Sanitation][85]
Oceans
SDG 14: Life Below Water aims to conserve and sustainably use the world's oceans, seas, and marine
resources by 2030. Key targets include reducing marine pollution, protecting ecosystems, ending
overfishing, and minimizing ocean acidification. It is critical for managing climate change,
biodiversity, and coastal livelihoods. The high-level 2025 United Nations Conference to Support the
Implementation of Sustainable Development Goal 14: Conserve and sustainably use the oceans, seas and
marine resources for sustainable development (the 2025 UN Ocean Conference) was co-hosted by France
and Costa Rica and held in Nice, France, from 9 – 13 June 2025. [2025 UN Ocean Conference][86]
[UNOC3 Political Declaration][87] [More on Oceans & Seas][88]
Small Island Developing States
Small Island Developing States (SIDS) face unique and interrelated challenges, including climate
change impacts, ocean degradation, limited resources, and structural vulnerabilities, while also
demonstrating leadership and innovation in advancing sustainable development. Strengthening
partnerships, mobilizing finance, and enhancing capacity-building are essential to support SIDS in
achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and ensuring that no one is left behind. The Fourth
International Conference on Small Island Developing States marked a key milestone in advancing SIDS
priorities and resulted in the adoption of the Antigua and Barbuda Agenda for SIDS, which provides a
renewed framework for action, partnerships, and implementation. [4th Conference on SIDS][89]
[ABAS][90] [SIDS Partnership Framework][91] [More on SIDS][92]
Stakeholder Engagement
Stakeholder engagement is central to advancing the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. The
High-level Political Forum on Sustainable Development (HLPF) serves as the United Nations’ main
platform for inclusive dialogue, bringing together governments, civil society, the private sector,
academia, and other stakeholders to share experiences, build partnerships, and strengthen
implementation of the Sustainable Development Goals. [More information][93] [Subscribe to mailing
list][94]

Energy

climate change. [Energy Compacts][80] [More on Energy][81]

crucial role in advancing the Sustainable Development Goals and to gather and rally new solutions,

Transport 2026 – 2035][82] [More on Sustainable Transport][83]
Water

ecosystems, and economic growth. Ensuring universal access to safe drinking water and sanitation,

# Effiziente und systemische Klima- und Energielösungen

Über uns

## Viessmann steht für Erfahrung, Qualität und Innovation

Innovationskraft ist der Schlüssel zur Zukunft. Deshalb arbeiten wir seit über 100 Jahren Tag für
Tag daran, die Grenzen des technisch Möglichen neu zu definieren – für unsere Kunden, unsere Partner
und zukünftige Generationen.

[ Mehr über unsere Marke erfahren ][58]
[Das Bild zeigt zwei Viessmann Mitarbeiter in der Produktion mit einer Wärmepumpe]
[Das Bild zeigt einen Mitarbeiter bei der Montage in der Produktionsstätte Allendorf.]
[Das Bild zeigt eine Familie und eine Wärmepumpe.]
[Das Bild zeigt das Hauptgebäude in Allendorf (Eder).]
Lösungen mit System

## Wir setzen auf ein intelligentes Portfolio

Heizen, Kühlen, Lüften und Strom erzeugen – mit unseren Energie- und Klimalösungen für Neubau und
Modernisierung verfolgen wir einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz. Intelligente Systemkomponenten sowie
digitale Services gewährleisten hohe Effizienz und Komfort.
* #### Wärme und Strom
  
  Unsere Energie- und Heizlösungen für Wohngebäude gewährleisten ein perfektes Zusammenspiel von
  Wärme und Strom. Das gilt für klassische sowie regenerative Technologien.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][59]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Produkte, einen Mann und eine Frau.]
* #### Klimaanlagen
  
  Optimales Raumklima und hohe Luftqualität – seit 2023 rundet der Bereich Klimaanlagen das
  Viessmann Climate Solutions Produktportfolio ab. Modernste Technologie vereint Effizienz und
  Komfort.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][60]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Vitoclima 300S Klimagerät an der Wand montiert]
* #### Lüftung
  
  Einzelne Räume oder gesamte Gebäude – unsere Lüftungssysteme gewährleisten einen geregelten
  Luftaustausch. Das wirkt sich positiv auf Luftqualität und Gebäudesubstanz aus.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][61]
  [Das Bild zeigt das Ventilation system und ein Mädchen]
* #### Gewerbe und Industrie
  
  Planung, Installation und Wartung – für unsere Kunden entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für
  eine wirtschaftliche Versorgung mit Wärme, Dampf und Strom.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][62]
  [Das Bild zeigt eine Industrieanlage im Hintergrund und ein Tablet mit Daten im Vordergrund.]
* #### Digitale Services
  
  Steuerung, Inbetriebnahme und Wartung – unsere digitalen Services ebnen den Weg zu noch mehr
  Effizienz und erleichtern sowohl unseren Kunden als auch unseren Partnern den Alltag.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][63]
  [Das Bild zeigt digitale Dienste auf einem Smartphone für die Energiekontrolle in Häusern.]

[Bild zeigt lachende Mitarbeiterin im Viessmann Werk Allendorf.]
[Das Bild zeigt ein Baumblatt mit Wassertropfen]
Nachhaltigkeit

## Wir leben Nachhaltigkeit

Unsere Herangehensweise an globale Nachhaltigkeitsherausforderungen basiert auf unserem Zweck, eine
lebenswerte Energiezukunft zu sichern. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das Klima und viele andere
Nachhaltigkeitsfragen.

[ Wie wir Nachhaltigkeit umsetzen ][64]
