Sponsoring

## Wir sind ein Team

Verantwortung zu übernehmen und im Team zu denken, sind wesentliche Bestandteile unserer
Unternehmenskultur. Das zeigt sich auch in unserem Engagement im Sportsponsoring. Seit 1993
unterstützen wir Athleten, Funktionäre sowie Verbände und pflegen enge Partnerschaften.

[ Wie wir uns im Sport engagieren ][65]
[Das Bild zeigt die Konzernzentrale in Allendorf (Eder)]
Standorte

### Wir sind international

Unser regionaler Hauptsitz ist Allendorf (Eder) in Nordhessen aber wir sind global aktiv. Unsere
effizienten Energie- und Klimalösungen sorgen weltweit für eine zuverlässige und komfortable
Versorgung mit Wärme, Kälte, Luft und Energie.

[ Wo du uns findest ][66]
[Das Bild zeigt einen Viessmann Mitarbeiter in der Produktion]
Karriere

### Wenn du mehr willst als einfach nur einen Job

Wir haben große Ziele vor Augen. Um diese zu erreichen, setzen wir unsere vielfältigen Talente ein.
Wer zu Viessmann Climate Solutions gehört, gestaltet die Energiewende mit und trägt dazu bei, den
Klimawandel zu bekämpfen.

[ Dein Job bei Viessmann Climate Solutions ][67]

### Über Viessmann Climate Solutions

1917 als Heiztechnik-Hersteller gegründet, ist Viessmann Climate Solutions heute ein weltweit
führender Anbieter für effiziente und systemische Klima- (Wärme, Wasser- und Luftqualität) und
erneuerbare Energielösungen. Das integrierte Viessmann Climate Solutions Portfolio verbindet
Produkte und Systeme über digitale Plattformen und Dienstleistungen nahtlos und schafft so ein
sicheres und verlässliches Wohlfühlklima für die Nutzer:innen. Viessmann Climate Solutions ist Teil
der Carrier Global Corporation, einem weltweit führenden Anbieter intelligenter Klima- und
Energielösungen.

## Wir setzen auf ein intelligentes Portfolio

Heizen, Kühlen, Lüften und Strom erzeugen – mit unseren Energie- und Klimalösungen für Neubau und
Modernisierung verfolgen wir einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz. Intelligente Systemkomponenten sowie
digitale Services gewährleisten hohe Effizienz und Komfort.

  Unsere Energie- und Heizlösungen für Wohngebäude gewährleisten ein perfektes Zusammenspiel von
  Wärme und Strom. Das gilt für klassische sowie regenerative Technologien.

  Viessmann Climate Solutions Produktportfolio ab. Modernste Technologie vereint Effizienz und
  Komfort.

  [ Mehr erfahren ][61]

## **PHÂN PHỐI THÉP XÂY DỰNG và PHÔI NHÔM (INGOT, BILLET)**

**VIMAS Solutions** cung cấp các sản phẩm **Thép **và **Phôi Nhôm** (Ingot, Billet), đáp ứng tiêu
chuẩn kỹ thuật và tiến độ cho các công trình xây dựng dân dụng và công nghiệp. Chúng tôi cam kết
mang đến giải pháp vật liệu tối ưu, góp phần xây dựng nền móng vững chắc cho tương lai.

Cộng tác với đội ngũ chuyên gia kỹ thuật và tư vấn giàu kinh nghiệm, **VIMAS Solutions** đóng vai
trò cầu nối giữa các nhà thương mại, nhà đầu tư, đơn vị phát triển và cơ quan quản lý trong lĩnh vực
năng lượng. Chúng tôi hỗ trợ triển khai các dự án năng lượng truyền thống (dầu khí), năng lượng tái
tạo, năng lượng sạch và tối ưu hóa hiệu quả sử dụng năng lượng.

Nam, cũng như các công ty Việt Nam mong muốn mở rộng ra thị trường quốc tế. Chúng tôi cung cấp dịch
vụ đại diện thương mại, hỗ trợ kỹ thuật và phát triển thị trường, giúp khách hàng vượt qua rào cản

## **VIMAS Solutions**

Là doanh nghiệp đa lĩnh vực, năng động và tiên phong trong việc kết nối giá trị quốc tế với thị
trường Việt Nam.
Chúng tôi hoạt động trên ba trụ cột chiến lược

## **PHÂN PHỐI THÉP XÂY DỰNG và PHÔI NHÔM (INGOT, BILLET)**

**VIMAS Solutions** cung cấp các sản phẩm **Thép **và **Phôi Nhôm** (Ingot, Billet), đáp ứng tiêu
chuẩn kỹ thuật và tiến độ cho các công trình xây dựng dân dụng và công nghiệp. Chúng tôi cam kết
mang đến giải pháp vật liệu tối ưu, góp phần xây dựng nền móng vững chắc cho tương lai.

[ Chi tiết ][14]

## **TƯ VẤN & PHÁT TRIỂN NĂNG LƯỢNG, DẦU KHÍ**

Cộng tác với đội ngũ chuyên gia kỹ thuật và tư vấn giàu kinh nghiệm, **VIMAS Solutions** đóng vai
trò cầu nối giữa các nhà thương mại, nhà đầu tư, đơn vị phát triển và cơ quan quản lý trong lĩnh vực
năng lượng. Chúng tôi hỗ trợ triển khai các dự án năng lượng truyền thống (dầu khí), năng lượng tái
tạo, năng lượng sạch và tối ưu hóa hiệu quả sử dụng năng lượng.

[ Chi tiết ][15]

## **ĐẠI DIỆN THƯƠNG MẠI & DỊCH VỤ KỸ THUẬT**

**VIMAS Solutions** là đối tác tin cậy của các doanh nghiệp nước ngoài muốn tiếp cận thị trường Việt
Nam, cũng như các công ty Việt Nam mong muốn mở rộng ra thị trường quốc tế. Chúng tôi cung cấp dịch
vụ đại diện thương mại, hỗ trợ kỹ thuật và phát triển thị trường, giúp khách hàng vượt qua rào cản
địa phương và tăng trưởng bền vững.

[ Chi tiết ][16]

### CÔNG TY TNHH VIMAS SOLUTIONS

Là doanh nghiệp đa lĩnh vực, năng động và tiên phong trong việc kết nối giá trị quốc tế với thị
trường Việt Nam và ngược lại. Với tầm nhìn chiến lược và định hướng phát triển bền vững, VIMAS
Solutions không ngừng mở rộng năng lực, trở thành đối tác tin cậy của các doanh nghiệp trong và

# Shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy


Our everyday lives depend on a steady supply of electricity and goods shipped to us from across the
world.

Yet, marine and energy generate over a third of global greenhouse gases. That’s why we’re shaping
the decarbonisation of marine and energy.

[About us][8]

2050

net-zero target year
for shipping and energy

180

countries with our
energy installations

110,000

vessels sailing worldwide,
one-third using our solutions

3,500

Wärtsilä service professionals
in the field

## Enabling you to cut emissions at sea and on land

We help our customers take a decarbonisation journey that is environmentally sustainable and
financially viable.

[Senayan power plant in Indonesia]
[lightning-icon]
Energy

We help the energy sector accelerate the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future with our
market-leading technologies and power system expertise. Energy providers globally rely on our
flexible engine power plants, energy storage systems, intelligent optimisation technologies, and
lifecycle services. With reliable, affordable, and sustainable power as your goal, our solutions
support you in ramping up and balancing intermittent renewables.

[Wärtsilä in energy][9]
[Gas tanker on open sea]
[marine-icon]
Marine

With Wärtsilä as your partner, your maritime operations can be smarter, cleaner, and more efficient.
One in three of the world’s large vessels already relies on our technologies – power, propulsion and
other solutions – because you value reliability, safety, and performance. And as the industry moves
toward alternative fuels and digital ecosystems, we help you stay ahead with our future-proof
solutions.

[Wärtsilä in marine][10]
[Power plant in the desert]
[Service men at pier]
[Freight vessel in port]

## Interim report for April-June 2026 has been published

In the second quarter of 2026, Wärtsilä’s total order intake increased by 33% to 2,849 MEUR to an
all-time high quarter, contributing to an all-time high order book of 8,976 MEUR. The operating
result increased by 14% to EUR 209 million, representing 13.4% of net sales. Cash flow from
operating activities increased to EUR 497 million.

[Read more][11]

## Global impact. Succeeding together.

From world-first technology launches to performance-based agreements, we innovate to create value
with our customers and partners.

[
Solvang

Onboard carbon capture successfully cuts CO2 emissions by 70% for Solvang’s Clipper Eris carrier

][12][
Aqualectra, Curacao

Installed a new 38.4 MW grid balancing engine power plant in addition to the 25 MW / 45 MWh Energy
Storage System installed earlier.

][13][
GIGA Storage BV

Installed Wärtsilä's 25 MW / 48 MWh energy storage in the Netherlands, improving grid stability and
scaling renewable integration.

][14][
Viking Line

Finnish ferry company Viking Line is a market leader in passenger transport in the northern Baltic
Sea region.

][15][
United Power

United Power manages over 2,137 MW of installed capacity in Bangladesh, of which 1,066 MW is powered
by Wärtsilä engines.

][16][
Clearway Energy

Partnered with Wärtsilä for storage solutions supporting reliable renewable energy in California and
Hawaii.

][17]
[leaf-icon]
Green is not black or white.

While no single solution will carry us through the transition, we already have most of the
technology needed to decarbonise. From engines that run flexibly on low- and zero-carbon fuels to
AI-driven predictive analytics, we are using all tools in the toolbox to help our customers take the
next step on their decarbonisation journey.

[Our story][18]

**Where Does the Name Xanthus Come From? **

In Greek mythology, Xanthus was the name of Achilles horse, the offspring of Zephyrus, the west
wind. Xanthus was given the power of speech by the gods in order to tell Achilles who had killed his
friend Patroclus.

# **Xanthus Consulting International**

## Smart Grid Consulting

[transmission tower]

** Xanthus **provides ***Smart Grid*** engineering consulting services to the electric power
industry, focusing primarily on *information standards*, *cyber security requirements*, and
*integration of systems *for power system operations. Our focus areas include distributed energy
resources (DER), advanced metering infrastructure (AMI), demand response (DR), plug-in electric
vehicles (PEV), distribution automation (DA), substation automation, and energy market operations.

## What is the the Smart Grid?

Different definitions of the "***Smart Grid***" abound, with various definitions reflecting the
viewpoint of their authors - not unlike the 6 blind men and the elephant. Smart Grid is not only
Smart Meters, but also Smart Generation, Smart Operations, and Smart System Integration. The
official source, the federal [Energy Independence and Security Act (EISA)][25] of 2007 can possibly
be captured succinctly as follows:

*The term "Smart Grid" refers to a **modernization** of the electric power system through
**automation**, **new technologies**, and **new paradigms involving customers** in making
energy-related decisions.*

*The Smart Grid will **shift from the old-fashioned centralized grid management **with one-way flows
of power from bulk generation to customer loads, **to a future with decentralized energy
management** utilizing distributed generation and storage, renewable energy, microgrids, intelligent
appliances, and demand response by customers*.

*The Smart Grid will be enabled by international **information interoperability standards**, and
will be protected by **cyber security** to ensure highly reliable energy.*

## Power Systems Automations
## for a Net Zero Future

[Our Services][1]

## Welcome

Our mission is to improve, optimise, and automate grid consultancy services combining innovative
thinking with technical expertise as well as offer strategic advice to accelerate the connection of
renewables to the grid and the transition to a carbon-neutral future.

Like in many other industries, the engineering that we do in power systems ranging from detailed
dynamic studies to grid innovation and strategic grid connection advice, has many areas that can be
optimised and even automated. We are committed to identify these areas and apply innovative thinking
to make them more effective as well as to design tools that can be used directly by our clients.

## Who we work with

Our clients range from renewable generation developers, power systems consultants, grid innovators,
electricity network operators, equipment manufacturers through to landowners and investors, looking
to develop projects connecting into the electricity networks:
* Renewable generation developers
* Power systems consultants
* Grid innovators
* Electricity network operators
* Equipment manufacturers
* Landowners
* Investors

## Our Services

We offer flexible grid consultancy services designed and optimised to meet your project needs.

#### [Power Systems Studies][2]

Conducting power system studies is key for ensuring the secure, efficient, and dependable operation
of electrical networks.

#### [Curtailment Studies][3]

Grid flexibility modelling, curtailment assessment and support for grid innovation projects.

#### [Grid Connection Feasibility][4]

Grid feasibility studies enhance visibility, identify risks, and anticipate delays in the early
stages of generation projects. They play a vital role in the decision-making process of the project
investment.

#### [Grid connection Applications][5]

Complete preparation and submission of G99 and transmission connection applications.

#### [Offshore Windfarm Studies][6]

Offshore windfarm feasibility, design studies and optimisation.

#### [Power Quality Analysis][7]

Turning raw PQ data into actionable strategies for reliability and performance.

#### [Power Systems Automation][8]

Applying innovative thinking and automation is crucial for accelerating renewable integration.

#### [Earthing Studies][9]

Earthing design studies are essential to ensuring that the earthing system is capable of meetings
its safety and functional requirements.

#### [Engineering Design][10]

End-to-End Design Solutions for Solar PV, BESS, and Wind Projects.

### Get Our Services

Industry Leading Experts in Power Systems Studies Automation

[Contact Us][12]
